digest_separation.intent: CredentialPrivateActionData.nonsecret_intent_digest remains PayloadDigest of nonsecret intent only; never called ApprovalOperationDigest or a full authority operation digest.
digest_separation.transcript: LocalAuthorityTranscriptDigest is a distinct private hex32 DATA type. Future domain-separated canonical transcript includes profile version, outer scope tag and ALL complete branch fields; local branch covers every owner/install/root/channel/process/lifetime/initiation/custody/action/target/source/state transaction/predecessor/nonce/time field, including original intent digest. Exclude only its own transcript_digest field, never a scope/context field.
digest_separation.head: LocalAuthorityHeadDigest names the separate authority predecessor/head digest, not intent, full operation, StateContentDigest/mutation or vault result.
digest_separation.not_implemented: No signing-byte serializer/hash implementation or proof acceptance is supplied. Existing generic private data codecs are not a native signing transcript. Native authority runtime v1 does not accept this proposal/profile; no fallback to its pool operation parser.

state_transaction_not_authority.meaning: StateTransactionBinding binds installation-scoped StateStoreBinding, transaction_id, original operation_id, expected/current store revisions and mutation_digest. It is NOT authority generation/head and NOT vault completion.
state_transaction_not_authority.checks: Require installation StateScope, matching installation/device and original operation across store/context/action/initiation/custody; independently validate store generation and root authority generation in their own namespaces. Do not equate them.
state_transaction_not_authority.predecessor: LocalAuthorityExpectedHead is explicit absent/present/unknown. Present carries authority generation/revision/head digest. Known absent is only predecessor expectation under an ALREADY independently admitted protected root and verified anti-rollback baseline, never bootstrap permission. Missing/rolled-back/unreadable ledger is unknown, not known absence; unknown refuses effects.

untrusted_context_not_proof.owner: Unix UID or Windows SID is a configured equality description, not actual current OS principal/presence/consent. Authenticate the real principal through the retained protected native channel; never accept a caller UID/PID/name/boolean/descriptor as proof.
untrusted_context_not_proof.root: AuthorityRootId/generation/device/installation labels do not establish trust. Require actual independently admitted protected authority root, OS principal, installation incarnation and independent rollback/clone/reinstall fences. No Node key, self-signed descriptor, restored mutable store, or fabricated pool bootstraps trust.
untrusted_context_not_proof.channel: Settings channel describes endpoint, process observation, retained lifetime incarnation, channel incarnation and direction. IDs/hashes/process observations are DATA, not endpoint possession or presence. Retain and validate the actual endpoint/process/lifetime/direction; native initiation requires native_settings_to_authority, not reverse direction.
untrusted_context_not_proof.initiation: LocalAuthorityNativeInitiationDescription requires an actual active native Settings initiation bound to the exact original operation/current owner/channel. A described initiation is not a gesture. No remote/background/replayed request can prompt; identical retry attaches original UI/status without another prompt.

source_and_custody.expected_state: Source expectation is explicit absent/present/unknown. Unknown never becomes absence. Store may rely on known native-authorized absence; remove absent can report no targeted item only against exact current baseline; select requires actual retained present source and an implemented selection profile.
source_and_custody.targets: Stored targets carry name/exact target alias/storage/credential revision/precedence revision and expected source incarnation/revision. Store/remove target alias must equal immutable intent name, storage must match source kind, and all duplicated context/operation/revision fields must agree. Selected target separately carries actual source kind/alias (including non-file kinds), not a fake private-file target.
source_and_custody.locked_before_effect: Custody kind maps exactly store->credential_input, remove->removal_target, select_source->existing_source. Lock actual retained native input/source incarnation, exact custody attempt, holder/channel/initiation and operation to the complete immutable target before effect. Revalidate actual source identity, alias/storage, precedence revision and owner/root/install/channel at effect. Never substitute input/source after a prompt, silently follow changed precedence, or treat source IDs as retained handles.
source_and_custody.no_secret_representation: No raw secret/value/password/path/environment selector/code, secret length/hash/fingerprint or secret-derived public DTO. Incarnation/attempt identifiers and full transcript digest cover nonsecret bindings, not secret bytes. Required actual private custody binds the unchanged secret/source separately; descriptions alone grant nothing.
source_and_custody.private_provider_use: Provider credentials differ from admin signing keys. Necessary authorized private Node provider resolution/use remains permitted under exact purpose/origin/resource authorization; this leaf creates no provider proxy/service, arbitrary worker environment access or public secret export.
source_and_custody.selection_gap: Explicit persisted source selection remains disabled until actual selection semantics/native custody/profile exists; resolver precedence is not that implementation.

time_profile.unit: created_at/expires_at/initiated_at/locked_at/observed_at are UnixMicros. Checked conversion of seconds to microseconds is required at the profile boundary.
time_profile.checked_interval: Require checked subtraction with 0 < expires_at-created_at <= 300000000 microseconds, plus actual current-time/expiry and ordering checks; no unchecked conversion/overflow or unit confusion. This preserves 300 seconds, raises no limit and creates no new request-size budget.
time_profile.disabled: ProfileVersion1 is a private proposal data profile, not support in existing authority runtime v1. Canonical transcript, clocks, expiry and anti-rollback enforcement remain unimplemented.

observations_and_recovery.prebinding: LocalAuthorityBoundObservation and BoundActionState apply ONLY once full transcript/custody/action binding exists. Awaiting native and early cancellation/denial/expiry before binding use existing CredentialChangeView metadata; never fabricate a full transcript/custody attempt merely to fill an observation.
observations_and_recovery.state: Bound states prepared/committed/cancelled/denied/expired/outcome_unknown/recovery_required describe proposed observations, not authority or physical settlement. A committed StateTransactionBinding alone never proves vault write committed. Actual responsible native holder must genuinely settle/reconcile the effect before committed outcome.
observations_and_recovery.single_winner: Cancel/expiry and effect have one durable terminal winner; identical operation replay returns recorded original disposition with no rewrite. Mismatched scope/name/storage/source/revision/context refuses. Unknown write retains exact original operation/attempt/custody and reconciles, even after expiry; no automatic recapture, re-prompt or retry write.
observations_and_recovery.channel_root_loss: Channel death/root rotation revokes NEW effects, but cannot discard old-holder uncertain-write custody or ledger. Recovery/status requires authenticated current owner plus independently verified continuity and exact original operation. Do not pretend old channel is live, remint scope, replace custody attempt, re-prompt or rewrite. If continuity cannot be proven, retain unresolved state/custody without new effects.
observations_and_recovery.status_authorization: Check exact current scope/current authorization before replay or status disclosure; old DTO/digest alone reveals no disposition or result. No serialized observation or receipt is OS/native custody proof.
